subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android chat adopt tap-to-dictate with long-press voice-note capture as the supported replacement for the current separate composer controls?
rationale: This is a new user-facing input mode and gesture contract, not a repair of an established behavior; code review cannot determine whether that interaction model is the intended product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the unified input model
options.body: Confirm the tap-to-dictate and long-press voice-note interaction, then require final-APK recognizer-success proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the current separate controls
options.body: Decline the interaction change and close or narrow the PR rather than introducing a competing Android input model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the unified input model
recommendation.body: Confirm the tap-to-dictate and long-press voice-note interaction, then require final-APK recognizer-success proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this PR and authored the implementation commits for the dictation and microphone-ownership path.
